note: The first seam authored after the shape column (the call signature in the ledger's provides · requires) was in place. Both axis packs pin even the argument order in requires, so the seam's author does not have to guess a signature — this is the test bed for the very hole that produced 2 fatal defects in the node-api measurement.
boundaryNote: There is only one boundary. Vue is an SPA and node-api is a separate server, so there is a single HTTP boundary between the browser's fetch and the Express router — there is no second boundary of Server Components · Server Actions the way nextjs×supabase has. So every section of the contract applies to both sides and there is no surface: declaration.
policyEngineNote: The backend axis has no data-layer policy engine (dataLayerPolicyEngine: false). The application layer is the only boundary, so an ownership failure is returned as 404 rather than 403 — distinguishing them would let an unauthorized user enumerate the existence of resources. The frontend handles 404 in one screen as "absent, or not mine".
